882.text: Get off the beaten path and explore the island's finest local delicacies in the Katong district. Cycle at a leisurely pace with your guide between mouth-watering food stops and photo-ops.

339.label: name
339.text: Singapore: Sunset River Cruise and Light Shows Tour

971.label: location
971.text: Experience Singapore’s highlights after dark: a scenic river cruise, dazzling light shows, vibrant gardens, and a delicious feast at Lau Pa Sat. This tour reveals the magic of Singapore’s nightscape.

344.label: name
344.text: Jewel Changi Airport: Hedge Maze and Canopy Park Ticket

628.label: location
628.text: Embark on an adventure through Singapore's largest hedge maze located at Jewel Changi Airport then explore the 4 areas of nature and fun at Canopy Park.

349.label: name
349.text: LA: San Francisco, Yosemite, Vegas, Grand Canyon 7-Day Tour

837.label: location
837.text: Experience a 7-day tour to San Francisco, Las Vegas, Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon, Bryce Canyon, and Zion Park, departing from Los Angeles.

347.label: name
347.text: NYC: Sloomoo Institute Entry Ticket

715.label: location
715.text:
Enjoy an entry ticket to the Sloomoo Institute in New York. Immerse yourself in a universe of slime featuring handcrafted slime with varied textures, colors, and scents.
‍

341.label: name
341.text: Hong Kong: Egg Tart, Dumpling Cooking Class, Street Food

530.label: location
530.text: Learn to make Hong Kong's famous egg tarts and dumplings in a cooking class. Enjoy a communal dining experience where you can sample your creations.

333.label: name
333.text: Herons Creek: Bago Maze Entry Ticket

633.label: location
633.text: A stunning architectural hedge maze. One of the world’s largest hedge mazes with over 2000m of pathways. Located in the grounds of a boutique winery, surrounded by beautiful gardens and farmland.

343.label: name
343.text: Cape Town: 24-Minute Two Oceans Scenic Helicopter Flight

723.label: location
723.text: Experience a world-renowned 24-minute helicopter flight over Cape Town’s stunning shores. Soar above the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, take in panoramic views of iconic bays, and witness the breathtaking beauty of the Two Oceans route in a superb journey.

350.label: name
350.text: Dubai’s Best Desert Safari: Live Show & Gourmet BBQ Dinner

872.label: location
872.text: Experience Dubai’s golden dune bashing experience followed by a camel ride, live performances, and a 5-star BBQ at the exclusive Noble Camp. Fun, culture, and luxury under the stars!
